title: A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Synthetic Time Series Data
summary: A research pipeline and evaluation framework for generating and assessing synthetic time series data across configurable datasets, producing fidelity metrics and per-epoch model outputs. It trains and loads its synthetic data generator using SDV's PARSynthesizer with Metadata schema objects from sdv.metadata, making sdv.sequential.PARSynthesizer the core generation engine of the pipeline.
evidence: scripts/generating.py:4-65 imports PARSynthesizer from sdv.sequential, trains/loads it via PARSynthesizer.load(model_path)
